history.sprint: Sprint v1.4 — First Real Material Workflow
history.summary: Adopted the offline-generator resolution proposed for v1.3's conflict (1); built Module A docs/TeachingMaterials/scripts/GenerateTeachingMaterialData.js (Node, scans Repository, converts via the unmodified TeachingMaterialAdapter, writes js/data/TeachingMaterialData.js — a static, <script>-tagged data file, same convention as MockData.js; skips any Package failing ValidateMaterial.js rather than inlining it) and Module B js/runtime/TeachingMaterialLoader.js (browser coordinator, no material-content store of its own, same pattern as ImportRuntime.js; AHS.TeachingMaterialLoader.initialize() calls only existing MaterialRuntime.add()/SummaryRuntime.add()/QuestionRuntime.importQuestions()). Module C wired initialize() into js/pages/AppMaterials.js + AppQuiz.js bootstrap, plus 2 <script> tags each on materials.html/quiz.html. Modules D/E (Material Center/Summary) needed zero code changes — both already read exclusively via existing Runtime query APIs. Real architectural finding made and solved while building Module F (Practice): MaterialRuntime/SummaryRuntime rehydrate from sessionStorage on every page reload (this is a multi-page app, not an SPA) while QuestionRuntime is intentionally memory-only and isn't even <script>-tagged on materials.html — a naive Loader would either duplicate Material/Summary records on revisit or never reach QuestionRuntime on quiz.html at all. Fixed by persisting a small Package-id -> Runtime-id map (via the existing PersistenceAdapter) for Material/Summary idempotency, while deliberately re-running QuestionRuntime import on every page load where that Runtime exists. Second finding, disclosed not hidden: this app's own pre-existing '不得混用' design keeps '練習模式' (LearningQuestionRuntime) and Exam Mode (QuestionRuntime) strictly separate, and Exam Mode's session list is a fixed catalog (ExamData.js) with no dynamic entry point — so Teaching Material questions are genuinely stored/queryable in QuestionRuntime but have no live UI button reaching them yet, the same disclosed-gap pattern ImportRuntime.js already established. Verified via a realistic 3-page Node vm simulation (first visit / revisit — no duplicate / quiz.html without MaterialRuntime.js loaded — id correctly resolved via the persisted map) using scratch Package tm_997, deleted immediately after; js/data/TeachingMaterialData.js regenerated back to [] against the real, still-empty Repository before committing. npm run verify + npm test (175/175 + 6/6, including real jsdom loads of materials.html/quiz.html with 0 console errors) both clean. See docs/EO/Sprint_v1.4_FirstRealMaterialWorkflow_Report.md.
